rqii.sign_convention.value: mean_delta = score(PTO) - score(GRPO); gain = sign_of(metric) * mean_delta
rqii.sign_convention.note: positive gain = PTO was BETTER, on every instrument

rqii.pairing_unit.note: repeated measures; the same 96 personas face both methods

rqii.multiplicity.note: family = that grader's rows (instruments x look-ahead depths)

rqii.matched_on.note: NOT matched on spend: PTO's preference build is a phase GRPO does not have, so the same iteration is a different price. compute/cost holds the budget-matched reading.

rqii.matched_states.note: highest trained state both arms scored on every instrument
